messages:
Asha (eng-runtime): Heads up — nightly CI started failing on the paged-attention packaging step after the toolchain bump. error from audit: 
CI Bot: [build-3421] link error: /usr/bin/ld: unrecognized option '--icf=safe'
Asha (eng-runtime): Huh, that flag is coming from our build shim (packaging/ldflags.sh). It wasn't present before the gcc 12 -> 13 bump.
Michael T: Did the base container image change too? we had a mismatch last quarter where docker had binutils 2.40 but host made packages expecting 2.39.
Samir: I can repro locally with the slim-builder image — running `docker run --rm -it ghcr.io/redwood/slim-builder:gcc13 /bin/bash` then `make wheel` hits the same `--icf` error.
Ryan K: Looks like gold linker now rejects `--icf=safe`. Our shim adds it unconditionally when `USE_PGO=1`. Maybe toolchain defaults changed and we need a guard.
Jules: Also saw a perf regression in the fused kernel microbench when we rebuilt on gcc13 with -fno-plt removed. Profiling (simple perf record) showed key kernel symbols relocated differently.
Asha (eng-runtime): Can we do a two-prong action: 1) fix CI packaging check to detect unsupported ld flags; 2) rebuild kernels with explicit canonical flags matching runtime image? I can open a quick PR for #1.
CI Bot: <@Asha (eng-runtime)> created pull request: refs/pull/eng-runtime/packaging/ldflags-guard — CI will run.
Michael T: For #2, we should pin `-march` and `-fuse-ld` in the kernel build matrix. Rebuilding with `-fuse-ld=lld` avoided the `--icf` issue for me and produced identical symbol layout to previous builds.
Samir: Note: switching to lld changed codegen slightly; the KV-cache pointer offsets moved and one regression test (kv-eviction-bench) failed ~0.5% p99. We need to run the full perf harness before promoting.
Ryan K: Suggestion: add a packaging step that emits `nm -D` of the built kernel and compare a short hash to a golden for each kernel variant. If hash mismatch, fail and collect `objdump -d` for triage.
Jules: Agreed. Also add a small check in the runtime that logs linker id (ldd --version) during startup for private deploys so customers can correlate.
Asha (eng-runtime): I'll land the ldflags guard and the CI nm-hash collector. Samir/Ryan can coordinate the canonical build flags and perf re-run.
Samir: I'll run the full fused/paged benchmark suite on the lld build and post results here. If regressions are only in micro-bits we can accept them with notes.
Michael T: FYI, until we have the canonical artifacts, re-enabling the old builder image (gcc12) on the packaging runner is a safe rollback.
Asha (eng-runtime): Thanks all — tracking: PR merged, follow-up for canonical build flags tracked in issue #PR-431. If anyone hits the CI build locally ping me and I'll share the repro container.
